toc.title: The PID and the project log

html:
1The PID and the project log

Product Purpose
Project initiation documentation (PID) The baseline that sets out why, what, how, who, when and how much: the business case, the approaches, the team structure, the role descriptions and the project plan
Project log The records that change continually: the daily log, lessons log, risk register, issue register, quality register and product register

The approaches inside the PID

Approach Practice
Benefits management approach Business case
Sustainability management approach Business case
Commercial management approach Organizing
Quality management approach Quality
Risk management approach Risk
Issue management approach Issues
Change management approach People
Communication management approach People
Digital and data management approach Progress

[Verify live] The grouping of each approach.

The registers in the project log

Record Practice
Risk register Risk
Issue register Issues
Quality register Quality
Product register Quality
Daily log Progress
Lessons log Progress (and learn from experience)
Exam tip

. Approaches are in the PID (decided at the start). Registers and logs are in the project log (updated all the time). If an option puts a register in the PID, check carefully.

2Products by practice

Practice Main management products
Business case project brief, business case, benefits and sustainability approaches
Organizing team structure, role descriptions, commercial approach
Plans project product description, work package description, plans
Quality product description, quality approach, quality and product registers
Risk risk approach, risk register
Issues issue approach, issue register, issue report
Progress checkpoint, highlight, end stage, end project, lessons and exception reports; daily and lessons logs; digital and data approach

3Who sends which report

Report From to
Checkpoint report team manager to project manager
Highlight report project manager to project board
End stage report project manager to project board
Exception report project manager to project board
End project report project manager to project board
Exam tip

. Approaches sit in the PID; registers and logs sit in the project log. Learn which product goes with which practice.

Exam tip

. Checkpoint goes team manager to project manager; highlight, end stage, exception and end project go project manager to board.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Which product is the baseline that sets out why, what, how, who, when and how much?

  • AThe daily log
  • BThe highlight report
  • CThe PID
  • DThe issue report
Show the answer

Answer: C. The PID is the baseline for the project.

S2Which statements are CORRECT? (1) The risk register is part of the project log. (2) The quality management approach is part of the PID. (3) The daily log is part of the PID. (4) The checkpoint report goes to the project board.

  • A1 and 2
  • B3 and 4
  • C2 and 3
  • D1 and 4
Show the answer

Answer: A. The risk register is in the log; the quality approach is in the PID.

S3Identify the missing word. The [ ? ] register records the products and their status and approval.

  • ARisk
  • BIssue
  • CProduct
  • DQuality
Show the answer

Answer: C. The product register records the products.

S4Which management product belongs to the issues practice?

  • ARisk register
  • BProduct description
  • CWork package description
  • DIssue report
Show the answer

Answer: D. The issue report belongs to issues.

S5Who receives the highlight report?

  • AThe team manager
  • BProject support
  • CThe change authority only
  • DThe project board
Show the answer

Answer: D. The project manager sends it to the board.

S6Which of these is an approach inside the PID?

  • ADaily log
  • BRisk management approach
  • CEnd stage report
  • DException report
Show the answer

Answer: B. The risk management approach is part of the PID.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What does the PID contain?

Show the answer

The business case, the approaches, the team structure, role descriptions and the project plan.

R2Name the six parts of the project log.

Show the answer

Daily log, lessons log, risk register, issue register, quality register and product register.

R3Who sends the checkpoint report?

Show the answer

The team manager (to the project manager).

R4Which approach covers suppliers and contracts?

Show the answer

The commercial management approach.

R5Which products belong to the plans practice?

Show the answer

Project product description, work package description and plans.

R6Which practice owns the issue report?

Show the answer

Issues.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
PID baseline: business case, approaches, team structure, plan
Project log daily log, lessons log, risk, issue, quality and product registers
Reports to the board highlight, end stage, exception, end project
Checkpoint team manager to project manager
